hints.title: Minimum Required Potion Strength
hints.text: For a spell of strength s, the potion strength p must satisfy p >= ceil(success / s) = (success + s - 1) // s.

hints.title: Ordered Potion Strengths
hints.text: Sort the potions array in ascending order to enable logarithmic boundary searches.

hints.title: Counting Successful Combinations
hints.text: Binary search for the first potion >= min_p. If found at index idx, there are len(potions) - idx qualifying potions.

hints.title: Sorted Binary Search Pairs Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import bisect

class Solution:
    def successfulPairs(self, spells: list[int], potions: list[int], success: int) -> list[int]:
        potions.sort()
        m = len(potions)
        ans = []
        for s in spells:
            min_p = (success + s - 1) // s
            idx = bisect.bisect_left(potions, min_p)
            ans.append(m - idx)
        return ans
```

complexity.time: O(m log m + n log m)
complexity.notes: Sorting potions takes O(m log m); each spell query takes O(log m).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise multiplication of all spells and potions takes O(n * m) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Output array of size n stores pair counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate uses integer ceiling division and binary search to count valid potions efficiently.
